# Estate View

> A read-only visual browser for an "estate" of idea records. Each record
> accumulates typed artifacts (Spark, Framing, Horizon, Trajectory, Phase,
> Findings, Appraisal, Decision, Brief, Seed) written by named agents
> performing verbs, plus immutable state snapshots written by a single
> narrator called the Steward. Lineage is derived from each artifact's
> inputs; the Seed is the terminal export that leaves the walls.

This snapshot was generated 2026-08-31 18:05 and covers 4 records
(40 artifacts including seeds, 36 state snapshots, 2 exported).

## Records

- idea-0004: A UI for the estate — status active, appetite 3, 14 artifacts, 10 states, seeded (exports/0004-estate-ui-seed.md)
- idea-0001: The Estate — status active, appetite 3, 5 artifacts, 12 states, no export
- idea-0003: The Starvu agency site — status active, appetite 1 (placeholder), 19 artifacts, 13 states, seeded (exports/0003-starvu-agency-site-seed.md)
- idea-0002: The operator-supplied material seam — status active, appetite 1 (placeholder), 0 artifacts, 1 states, no export

## Full text

- https://idea-estate.com/llms-full.txt: every record, artifact summary, and state narration in this snapshot, as plain text.

## Notes for agents

- The interactive app at https://idea-estate.com/ renders the same data; there is no
  content behind interaction that is missing from /llms-full.txt.
- This tool is read-only by construction: nothing here writes to the estate.
